item.text: [{"task_id":"252143c9","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['config'][0]))","    divisor = int(round(params['config'][1]))","    zero = int(round(params['config'][2]))","    h, w = grid.shape","    if divisor <= 0 or bg < 0 or bg > 9:","        return grid.copy()","    cr, cc = h // divisor, w // divisor","    if cr >= h or cc >= w:","        return grid.copy()","    color = int(grid[cr, cc])","    points = np.argwhere(grid == color)","    best_score = -1","    best_direction = None","    for direction in params['directions']:","        dr = int(round(direction[0]))","        dc = int(round(direction[1]))","        if abs(dr) != 1 or abs(dc) != 1:","            continue","        score = 0","        for point in points:","            if (int(point[0]) - cr) * dr > zero and (int(point[1]) - cc) * dc > zero:","                score += 1","        if score > best_score:","            best_score = score","            best_direction = (dr, dc)","    if best_direction is None:","        return grid.copy()","    out = np.full((h, w), bg, dtype=int)","    dr, dc = best_direction","    r, c = cr, cc","    while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w:","        out[r, c] = color","        r += dr","        c += dc","    return out"],"shapes":{"config":[3],"directions":[4,2]},"params":{"config":[7,2,0],"directions":[[-1,-1],[-1,1],[1,-1],[1,1]]},"rationale":"The center cell selects the retained color.
